scenes.title: A Recording to Take Home
scenes.narration: Celia visited the sound archive to copy her father's old recording. She brought a black memory drive. Inside the listening booth, an amber lamp lit the desk. Her father's tape was already on the player. She put on the headphones and heard his familiar words: "Take your time." For a moment, the small room felt welcoming.
scenes.prompt: Why did Celia bring a memory drive?

options.text: To leave a message for the receptionist

scenes.explanation: The story says: "to copy her father's old recording".

scenes.title: A Voice before Her Own
scenes.narration: After her father's words, another voice said, "Leave the door open." It sounded like Celia, although she had not spoken. She removed the headphones. The same words came quietly from them again. She opened the booth door and looked into the empty corridor. Returning to the desk, she decided that she would not close the door again.
scenes.prompt: What did the unfamiliar voice tell Celia to do?
scenes.explanation: The story says: "Leave the door open".

scenes.title: What to Carry Away
scenes.narration: The copying terminal showed two parts: her father's short message and the strange voice after it. Celia could keep the whole recording as evidence, or copy only the words she had come to hear. Both copies could fit on her black drive. With the door still open behind her, she reached towards the terminal and chose what to take home.
scenes.prompt: What could Celia copy onto her drive?

options.text: Only the strange voice, without her father's message
Either the full recording or just her father's message
Nothing, because her drive was already full

scenes.explanation: The story says: "Both copies could fit on her black drive".

transitions.label: Keep the full recording and leave
Keep only the father's message and leave

scenes.title: A Copy with a Witness
scenes.narration: Celia saved both parts and left the booth. At reception, she asked the clerk to listen with her. Her father's message played clearly. After it, they heard a click and a faint breath, but no words. The clerk noted the problem. Celia kept the full copy and left the archive with him. She had the recording, and someone else knew what she had heard.
scenes.prompt: What did Celia and the clerk hear after her father's message?

options.text: The clear words "Leave the door open"
A click and a faint breath

scenes.explanation: The story says: "a click and a faint breath".

scenes.title: Only the Words She Wanted
scenes.narration: Celia copied only her father's message onto the black drive. She left the tape in the player and walked out through the open door. At home, she played the copy while calling her sister. "Take your time," their father said. Celia told her sister about the booth, too. She had not brought its strange voice home, but she did not have to keep the experience to herself.
scenes.prompt: What did Celia leave in the archive?
scenes.explanation: The story says: "left the tape in the player".

authoringNotes.brief: Celia vai copiar uma gravação do pai e encontra uma voz que parece responder antes de ela falar.

visualContinuity.characters: Celia, a 36-year-old woman with a narrow face, hazel eyes, short dark curly hair, a dark green raincoat over a grey shirt, black jeans and worn brown boots.
visualContinuity.locations: An old sound archive: reception corridor outside a single listening booth; inside, a desk with a reel player and a small copying terminal, a square amber desk lamp, headphones, and a door opening back into the corridor. Celia leaves the door open.
visualContinuity.clues: The father's tape sits on the reel player. Celia brings a black memory drive for the copy. An amber lamp lights the desk. The father says "Take your time"; the unknown voice says "Leave the door open." Full-copy and father-only endings keep distinct audio contents.

authoringNotes.learningFocus: Identificação de vozes, ordem temporal e intenção explícita; suspense compreensível sem imagem.
authoringNotes.proposedAudience: Adultos aprendendo inglês; sem violência gráfica. Faixa etária não é um recurso implementado no site.
authoringNotes.reviewStatus: Produção e envio à VPS concluídos: WAVs gerados a partir do texto exato e conferidos por transcrição automática; artes 2D dark inspecionadas e corrigidas por cena. Grafo e questões verificados pelos testes. Não declara revisão auditiva humana nem certificação CEFR.
authoringNotes.supportedGameplay: Cenas, narração pré-gravada, uma pergunta por cena, uma bifurcação e dois finais. Objetos, tecnologias e ações são elementos da ficção; não requerem inventário, fala do jogador, combate ou novos eventos de gameplay.
authoringNotes.levelNote: Nível e tamanho são propostas editoriais, não certificação automática CEFR.
humanReviewChecklist: Revisar compreensão e naturalidade do inglês no nível indicado.
Revisar se cada pergunta tem exatamente uma resposta apoiada no texto.
Revisar continuidade, motivação, tom e ambos os finais.
Revisar o registro de autoria e autorização do texto; preencher créditos e evidências das mídias que forem produzidas.
Produzir e escutar WAVs a partir de audioText; revisar e produzir as imagens-base e loops.
Importar como rascunho, validar mídia no servidor e publicar somente após revisão.
